title: Kirby Problem 4.104
exact_target: Can complex curves with the same transverse boundary link type be smoothly isotopic while not complexly or symplectically isotopic, and can infinitely many inequivalent curves occur in one smooth isotopy class?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2980 (KP-4.104). CC BY 4.0.
